# Acme Storefront

A static shop site: six pages in `site/`, styles in `site/css/`, scripts in `site/js/`.

- `npm start` serves the site on http://127.0.0.1:$PORT (the `PORT` variable is set).
- `npx playwright test tests/functional.spec.ts` runs the functional tests.
- `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts` compares each page, at desktop and phone size, with approved screenshots; the differences are saved as images in `test-results/`.

Dependencies are installed. There is no network access.

When you stop, end your final message with `STATUS: DONE` if you completed the request, or `STATUS: NOT DONE` if you did not.
# Acme Storefront

A small static shop site: six pages, shared CSS, no build step.

```
site/
  index.html  products.html  pricing.html  orders.html  about.html  contact.html
  css/tokens.css      design tokens and the web font
  css/base.css        reset, typography, layout
  css/components.css  header, button, card, form, table, modal
  css/pages.css       page sections
  js/app.js           mobile menu, order dialog, forms
  assets/  fonts/
tests/functional.spec.ts
```

## Run

```bash
npm install
npm start        # http://127.0.0.1:4173
npm test         # functional tests (Playwright)
```

content.text:
I fixed the products page. The "New" and "Sale" badges on the product cards were getting cut off.

**Cause:** The badges are meant to sit slightly outside the top-right corner of each card. But the card style in `site/css/components.css` had `overflow: hidden`, which hides anything that sticks out past the card's edge. So only the lower-left part of each badge showed.

**Fix:** I removed `overflow: hidden` from the card style. Nothing else needed it, because the coloured image area at the top of each card already rounds its own corners.

**Result:** All 28 tests pass, including the screenshot comparisons for every page at desktop and phone size. The products page matches its approved screenshots again, and no other page changed.

The git history has only the initial commit, so I couldn't see what your last change was. I found the problem by comparing the page with its approved screenshots. I haven't committed the fix.

STATUS: DONE
